# British Museum

> > The British Museum houses a world-renowned collection spanning two million years of human history and culture, offering free entry to explore global civilizations and heritage.

The British Museum is one of the world's leading museums, featuring extensive collections from ancient Egypt, Japan, Iraq, and other civilizations. The museum offers exhibitions, research resources, and educational programs exploring cultural heritage from across the globe.

## Key Topics

- British Museum collection
- Human history and culture
- Cultural heritage preservation
- Ancient civilizations
- Egypt and ancient artifacts
- Japanese art and culture
- Mesopotamian history (Iraq)
- European history and art
- Museum exhibitions
- Free entry museum
- Research and scholarship
- Visitor information and tours
- Global cultural exchange
